_edit: Edit each release: version is the release number (csproj <Version>), 2 to 4 items. title says what it is, how says where to click to try it now.

items.title: Update available
items.how: When a new Forsk is out, the gear gets a red dot. Open Settings and click Update available.

items.title: Connect Rhino to your account
items.how: Settings → Set up Forsk → Connect. Confirm the code in your browser and your licence follows you to every Mac.
